Evidence source SYN-0092 | Windows cannot find network printer
Problem: Windows cannot find network printer on macOS. Please help because I need this for work.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Cleared the print queue and reinstalled the approved printer driver.

Evidence source SYN-0048 | Company VPN connects then immediately disconnects
Problem: Company VPN connects then immediately disconnects on Windows 10. It happens on my work laptop.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Updated the VPN client and re-created the connection profile.

Evidence source SYN-0044 | Remote access VPN drops after login
Problem: Remote access VPN drops after login on Ubuntu. The issue happens repeatedly.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Updated the VPN client and re-created the connection profile.
